title: Daily routine
objectives: detail full daily schedules with time prepositions
use frequency adverbs in complex routines

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Daily routine.
Welcome to today's lesson: Daily routine! Today we will practice how to detail full daily schedules with time prepositions.

elements.content: detail full daily schedules with time prepositions; use frequency adverbs in complex routines

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: shower, always, usually, sometimes, never

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Which preposition goes before exact times (e.g. 7 o'clock)?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: I usually get up at seven o'clock, have breakfast, and go to work on weekdays.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
My daily routine starts early. I always wake up at six, take a shower, and usually go to work at eight.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Compare your daily routine with your partner's routine.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: detail full daily schedules with time prepositions, use frequency adverbs in complex routines.
